title: feat(nsnnxin): nnseed x-probe own-lock-in exist-opposite: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Own-lock-in on nnseed x-probes: L(A)=-e2 is the only negative letter in the whole configuration and it produces face hold via -e2/+e2 at C/D, while reverse still fails. The runner gate 'own-lock-in-does-not-recover-later-tick-reverse' records that the same cell fails reverse at the later tick too.
